name: web-inspector
description: Full QA for any website you own: a real-Chrome scan for broken pages and links, errors, accessibility (with a keyboard check), SEO, phone speed and Lighthouse scores, screenshot comparison, and HTTPS; a read-only security check; plain-word click-and-type journeys; a load test; plain-words "how to fix" advice, a summary for many sites, HTML reports and a GitHub Actions setup.
